text: Wow, I have never seen this: human digital logic. [VIDEO] Kids acting as bits in a machine register and performing binary arithmetic by raising their hands if set, or not raising when cleared. Really cute.

story: Jean Sammet, co-creator of COBOL, has died
text: Or was it a product of the computers at the time? Here's a 1959 computer, donated to a school in 1965. This was filmed in 1969. One of the children wrote a language - minigol - so the younger children didn't have to use assembler. [VIDEO] Just turning the machine on requires coordination between several people using intercom.

story: "This Is Not the Computer for You"
text: Is this close enough? it’s from 1969, I wonder what became of them: “Tomorrow's World: Nellie the School Computer 15 February 1969 - BBC” [VIDEO]
